window_geometry_fixed.previous_mistake: I passed the four integers as (800,600,100,100) which the code treats as X=800, Y=600, width=100, height=100
window_geometry_fixed.correct_order: (X, Y, width, height); passing (100,100,800,600) produced client=800x600 and window=806x629 at 877,406
window_geometry_fixed.how_confirmed: the host printed its own object fields obj+0x2c=877 obj+0x30=406 obj+0x34=800 obj+0x38=600 and its GetClientRect
window_geometry_fixed.renderdevice_settings_width_height: the width and height given to CreatePrimarySurface are the render target size, separate from the window geometry

colour_order_finding: I set the clear colour to (1,0,1,1) and observed pure blue, so the Color struct is byte-ordered BGR (or the channels map differently than RGB). The emitted value is blue, not magenta.
what_this_proves: the swapchain is genuinely bound and being presented to
the shipped renderer produced the visible pixels, not a reimplementation
Clear and PresentSurface work in our host when the window geometry is right
remaining_oddity: The in-process capture reported rect 2576x1479 at -8,-19 even though GetWindowRect reported 806x629 at 877,406 moments earlier; the pixel colours are still conclusive because they changed from black to pure blue only after Clear.
